content.short: Jet Protocol enables efficient borrowing and lending on Solana with tight collateral ratios and dynamic pricing.
content.description: Jet Protocol leverages Solana's speed to enable efficient borrowing and lending with dynamic pricing and tight collateral ratios. The governance token JET enables decentralized governance and security for the protocol. Core features include cross-chain modules that work to equalize interest rates, leveraged borrowing with automated position management, and secondary markets for interest-rate speculation. It also provides liquidity provisioning for senior and junior debt positions across Solana, Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, OP Mainnet, and Polygon.
